integrity: The finite proof uses exact bitwise Gaussian elimination over F_2 and exhaustive enumeration of all 2^25 structure matrices; two group-orbit algorithms reproduce the full abstract stabilizer-type table, and an independent orbital-matrix Burnside count confirms the total. Prior general isomorphism and Burnside theory is credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-field census only for five-dimensional perfect evolution algebras over F_2. Does not assert any all-dimension or all-field formula, or distinguish conjugacy classes of embeddings of the same abstract automorphism group.
title: Complete automorphism-type spectrum of five-dimensional perfect binary evolution algebras
